meta.name: experimental-design
meta.description: Design experiments and studies BEFORE data is collected — choosing a design, randomizing, blocking, and laying out treatment combinations so results are interpretable. Use whenever someone is planning a study, asks how to assign subjects/samples to groups, mentions randomization, blocking, stratification, controls, factorial or fractional-factorial designs, design of experiments (DOE), screening many factors, response-surface optimization, crossover or repeated-measures or split-plot designs, cluster/group randomization, Latin squares, plate layouts, batch/run-order effects, replication vs. pseudoreplication, or sequential/adaptive/group-sequential designs. Trigger even for informal phrasings like "how should I set up this experiment", "how do I avoid confounding", "what's the best way to test these 6 factors", or "assign these mice to conditions". For computing the sample size or power once the design is chosen, use statistical-power; for analyzing data already collected, use statistical-analysis.

copy.tagline: 设计实验方案，确保结果可解释
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你正在规划实验但不确定如何分配样本或处理
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are planning an experiment and unsure how to assign samples or treatments

howto.what: 这个技能帮助用户在设计实验时选择合适的设计类型（如完全随机、区组、析因等），生成随机化分配方案和设计矩阵，并指出常见的结构性错误（如假重复、混杂），确保结果可解释。
howto.when: 当用户正在规划研究、询问如何分配受试者或样本、提到随机化、区组、因子设计等关键词时触发。也适用于“如何设置实验”、“如何避免混杂”等非正式问法。

say.text: 如何将60名患者随机分配为治疗组和对照组？
say.note: 获得一个区组随机化的分配方案。

say.text: 我需要一个7个因素的筛选设计。
如何避免细胞实验中的假重复？
say.note: 解释假重复问题并给出正确重复层次的建议。

howto.what_en: This skill helps users choose experimental designs (e.g., completely randomized, blocked, factorial), generate randomized allocation schedules and design matrices, and identify common structural mistakes (e.g., pseudoreplication, confounding) to ensure interpretable results.
howto.when_en: Triggered when planning a study, asking about subject/sample assignment, or mentioning randomization, blocking, factorial designs, etc. Also triggered by informal phrasings like "how to set up this experiment".

say_en.text: How do I randomize 60 patients into treatment and control?
I need a screening design for 7 factors.
How to avoid pseudoreplication in cell experiments?
say_en.note: Explains pseudoreplication and suggests correct replication level.
